title: SAIC (SAIC) Tops Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
text: SAIC (SAIC) came out with quarterly earnings of $3.01 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2.25 per share. This compares to earnings of $3.63 per share a year ago.

title: Rocket Companies Names Alessio Sanfilippo Chief Executive Officer of Redfin
text: Former Meta and Intuit executive brings more than two decades of product, data and AI experience to Redfin Click here to download high resolution headshot DETROIT and SEATTLE, August 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT) today announced that Alessio Sanfilippo has been named Chief Executive Officer of Redfin, effective immediately. Sanfilippo joins Redfin from Meta, where he served as Vice President of Insights for Reality Labs.
